scope_limits: This manifest archives this fresh ten-command run. It does not rerun or reclassify historical evidence.
The exhaustive 2001-roll capture-envelope endpoint enumeration was NOT rerun by this session; test_eo_capture_coverage is a directed writer/selector/marker suite.
No full-top synthesis, implementation, route, timing, bus-skew or structural CDC audit is part of these ten commands. The parent records the fresh route separately.
No MCU calibration journal, payload, STM32 HAL, or physical sensor/filter-response suite was rerun by these ten commands.
Functional CDC simulations do not demonstrate metastability margin or physical bundled-bus constraints.
Finite directed/random/fixture tests do not exhaust the complete production system state space.
Pixel comparisons use stable optical geometry; camera-angle C equivalence is a separate property.
No hardware programming, physical stabilization, exposure latency, or sustainable unique-content frame rate is established.
Renderer raster files are hashed in place but not copied to this small evidence archive; all comparison logs are retained.
